name: Commitment
overview: Scripture emphasizes unwavering commitment to God and His purposes, illustrated by the call to bind one's soul to the Lord through vows (Numbers 30:2) and to entrust one's ways and works to Him for establishment (Psalms 37:5; Proverbs 16:3). Jesus underscores the total devotion required to love God with all heart, soul, and mind (Matthew 22:37) and warns that half-heartedness, like looking back after putting one's hand to the plough, disqualifies one from the kingdom of God (Luke 9:62). The reminder to 'Remember Lot's wife' (Luke 17:32) further highlights the danger of divided commitment and the necessity of steadfastness in following Christ.
